title: CRISPR/Cas9/AAV-Mediated Homologous Recombination in Mouse HSPCs
author: Tran, Trombke, et al.

steps.title: Prepare iodixanol gradients
steps.instruction: In a 29.9 mL Beckman Opti‑Seal ultra‑centrifuge tube, underlay sequentially 6 mL of 15 % iodixanol, 6 mL of 25 % iodixanol, 5 mL of 40 % iodixanol and 5 mL of 60 % iodixanol using a 10 mL syringe with a 14‑gauge needle; avoid air bubbles by tapping the syringe and releasing slowly; fill the tube to the top with balancing buffer, balance the two tubes within 0.01 g, and store at 4 °C for up to 15–18 h if needed.

substeps.instruction: Add 6 mL 15 % iodixanol to the bottom of the tube.
Underlay 6 mL 25 % iodixanol gently.
Underlay 5 mL 40 % iodixanol gently.
Underlay 5 mL 60 % iodixanol gently.
Fill to the top with balancing buffer and balance tubes.

steps.title: Load cell lysate onto gradients
steps.instruction: Using a 20‑gauge needle with the bevel up, slowly drip the ~15 mL AAV cell lysate (or split equally onto two tubes) onto the top of each gradient, establishing a flow along the tube wall to avoid disturbing the layers.

steps.title: Ultracentrifuge gradients
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a Beckman Type 70Ti rotor and centrifuge at 345,322 × g for 2 h 10 min at 18 °C.

steps.title: Extract AAV‑containing layer
steps.instruction: In a sterile hood, clean the Opti‑Seal tube with ethanol, remove the black cap, and using a 10 mL syringe with an 18‑gauge needle (bevel up) insert the needle 1–2 mm above the 60 % iodixanol layer; withdraw 3–5 mL of the 40 % iodixanol layer, turning the needle bevel down after half the volume to collect the remainder, while avoiding the 25 %/40 % protein interface and the 60 % layer.

substeps.instruction: Clean tube with ethanol and a Kimwipe.
Remove black cap.
Insert needle 1–2 mm above the 60 % layer (bevel up).
Withdraw 3–5 mL of the 40 % layer, turning bevel down after half the volume.
Avoid collecting the white protein band at the 25 %/40 % interface.

steps.title: Store purified AAV
steps.instruction: Keep the extracted AAV fraction at 4 °C for several days or at –80 °C for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Dissect femurs/tibias and flush marrow
steps.instruction: From 8–12‑week‑old mice, remove muscles from left and right femurs and tibias, place each bone in a 6‑well plate containing 3 mL FACS buffer, and flush the marrow with a 1 mL syringe and 25‑gauge needle repeatedly until bones appear white; collect the suspension in a 15 mL tube, wash the well once with 5 mL FACS buffer, then centrifuge at 400 × g for 7 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Lyse red blood cells
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 2 mL red‑blood‑cell lysis buffer, pipette up/down 10×, incubate on ice 5 min, add 10 mL FACS buffer, centrifuge 400 × g 7 min 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend in 2 mL FACS buffer, pipette 10×, count total BM cells, then centrifuge again at 400 × g 7 min 4 °C and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Fc block
steps.instruction: Resuspend the BM cell pellet in 382 µL FACS buffer, add 10 µL anti‑mouse CD16/32 (Fc block), and incubate 10 min on ice.

steps.title: Stain with Sca1‑FITC
steps.instruction: Add 8 µL anti‑mouse Sca1‑FITC antibody, mix by pipetting up/down 10×, and incubate 10 min on ice in the dark.

steps.title: Wash Sca1‑FITC cells
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL FACS buffer, centrifuge at 400 × g for 7 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 320 µL FACS buffer.

steps.title: Add magnetic microbeads
steps.instruction: Add 80 µL α‑FITC MicroBeads to the 320 µL suspension, mix well, and incubate 15 min at 4 °C, vortexing briefly every 5 min.

steps.title: Wash after beads
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL FACS buffer, centrifuge 400 × g 7 min 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 500 µL FACS buffer.

steps.title: Load LS column
steps.instruction: Insert an LS separation column with wings into the MACS separator, place a 50 µm sterile BD cup‑type filcon on top, rinse the column with 3 mL FACS buffer through the cup, load the 500 µL cell suspension through the cup into the column, wash the cup twice with 500 µL FACS buffer, and collect the flow‑through (Sca1‑) in a 15 mL tube for later purity assessment.

substeps.instruction: Insert LS column and BD cup‑type filcon.
Rinse column with 3 mL FACS buffer.
Load 500 µL cell suspension.
Wash cup twice with 500 µL FACS buffer.
Collect unlabeled (Sca1‑) effluent.

steps.title: Wash column and elute Sca1+ cells
steps.instruction: Remove the BD cup, wash the LS column three times with 3 mL FACS buffer each after the reservoir is empty, place the column on a fresh 15 mL collection tube, add 5 mL FACS buffer onto the column, and immediately flush the magnetically labeled Sca1+ cells by firmly applying the supplied plunger.

substeps.instruction: Remove BD cup.
Wash column 3 × 3 mL FACS buffer.
Place column on collection tube.
Add 5 mL FACS buffer.
Flush Sca1+ cells with plunger.

steps.title: Count and assess purity
steps.instruction: Count the eluted Sca1+ cells with a hemocytometer; stain aliquots of the pre‑MACS, Sca1‑ and Sca1+ fractions with lineage cocktail, c‑Kit and Sca1 antibodies for 15 min at 4 °C, wash, and analyze by flow cytometry using FlowJo.

steps.title: Resuspend and culture Sca1+ cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the Sca1+ cells, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in StemSpan™ SFEM II medium supplemented with mouse SCF 50 ng/mL, TPO 50 ng/mL, Flt3‑L 50 ng/mL and human IL‑11 50 ng/mL at a density of 2 × 10⁵ cells/mL; plate 4 × 10⁵ cells (2 mL) per well of a 6‑well plate.

steps.title: Passage cells next day
steps.instruction: The following morning transfer 1 mL of the culture to a new 6‑well well and add 1 mL fresh HSPC medium to maintain 2 mL total volume and a cell density ≤2 × 10⁵ cells/mL.

steps.title: Optional proliferation assay
steps.instruction: a) Wash 1 × 10⁶ Sca1+ cells twice with 10 mL PBS, centrifuge, resuspend in 1 mL PBS, add CellTrace violet to a final 5 µM concentration, mix 10×, and incubate 15 min at 37 °C in the dark. b) Wash labeled cells with 10 mL StemSpan™ SFEM II, centrifuge. c) Culture as described in steps “Resuspend and culture” and “Passage cells” maintaining ≤2 × 10⁵ cells/mL. d) After 48 h, assess proliferation by flow cytometry. Critical: keep cell density low (≤2 × 10⁵/mL) for high HR efficiency.

substeps.instruction: Wash and resuspend cells in PBS.
Label with CellTrace violet (5 µM) for 15 min at 37 °C.
Wash with StemSpan™ SFEM II medium.
Culture under standard conditions.
Analyze proliferation by flow cytometry after 48 h.
